title: Grandshaykh (q) Used to Meet the Prophet (s) in A Waking State
body:
I will have Hisham Effendi make a copy of that book for me. Everyone must know that Imam Suyuti’s hadiths
are very powerful. Regarding Imam Suyuti’s level, they say that he used to meet with Prophet (s) yakazhatan,
in a waking state. (Amanna wa sadaqna!) I love Imam Suyuti very much!
Shaykh Yahya Sabbah Hazretleri, may Allah sanctify his secret, used to go to Muhyiddin Ibn `Arabi Mosque
for jumu`ah prayers. When you enter the mosque, his maqaam is on the left side, above the stairs. That is
where Shaykh Yahya used to sit and make takreer. Although he was ummiyy, unlettered, he used to make
suhbahs from Ibn `Arabi’s suhbahs, and he always kept six or seven people around him. Whenever
Grandshaykh (q) would pass by, Shaykh Yahya would immediately stand up to greet him. And he was quite a
heavy man, so it would take four men to lift him up just so he could hug and kiss Grandshaykh (q). After
greeting and making du`as for each other he would then go back up. In fact, whenever Shaykh Yahya saw
Grandshaykh (q), even while sitting inside a small car, he would always stand up for him. That’s how much
respect he held for Grandshaykh (q)! (...)
Anyways, yaa Hajjati Naziha! Inshaa-Allah, I will also have Naziha dressed in a white, embellished abaya,
covered from head to toe. Inshaa-Allah you will descend on Sham. With Allah’s permission, you will become
hajjati! (Mawlana Shaykh Hisham: Allahu Akbar! Tamaam Sayyidee!) (...)

One time, Shaykh Abdul Wahhab looked at me and said, “Yaa shaykh! Who is your shaykh?”
I said, “If my shaykh has accepted, my shaykh is Shaykh `Abd Allah Daghestani.”
He stood up and said, “Alzimhu! Yaa waladee, alzimhu! Fa innahu al-fareedal-waheed, allatee yajtami` ma`a
Rasoolillah (saw), yakazhatan laa manaaman!” “Hold fast to him, my son, hold fast to him! For he is the
single, only one who meets with the Prophet of Allah (s) in a waking state, not in his sleep.” (Allahu Akbar!
Allahu Akbar! Allahu Akbar!)
Look at the power of Grandshaykh (q)! If not for his power, I could not open my mouth here. Such blessed
ones. Allah Allah! He said, “He is the only one in Sham who can yakzhatan laa manaaman, alzimhu!” May
Allah sanctify his secret. Our shaykh is a lion! Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah.
Imam Suyuti is also yakazhatan, where he would physically meet with Prophet (s). So what right or authority
do you have (O Wahhabis) to call his hadiths weak? (Hajjah Naziha: They are Wahhabis, Shaykh Al-Albani.)
Those dogs! His father (Al-Albani) was Albanian. He used to get mad at his son and scold him for leaving
Ahlu ’s-Sunnah wa ‘l-Jama`ah. A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajim. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'rRaheem.
Lefke, 27.05.2011 (Translated from Turkish)
